Targeting .env files containing confidential credentials for AWS, Microsoft Office 365, SendGrid, Twilio
Abusing SMTP functions to scan and exploit exposed credentials and APIs
Creating fake pages on compromised websites to provide backdoor access
Creating new AWS users and user policies using stolen credentials
Spinning up new AWS instances for scanning additional vulnerable targets

Compromise of .env files containing cloud credentials
Abuse of SMTP protocol and exposed APIs
Use of stolen credentials to create backdoors and new AWS instances

Presence of unrecognized PHP files in root or /vendor/phpunit/phpunit/src/Util/PHP folder
